scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json
scripts.build: npm run check:boundaries && npm run notices && vite build && esbuild src/cli/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/cli/index.js --metafile=dist/cli/meta.json && node implementation/validation/import-boundaries.mjs --bundle dist/cli/meta.json && chmod +x dist/cli/index.js
scripts.test: npm run check:boundaries && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:integration && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration:built
